first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus archive-internal DTM tile filenames and dataset-specific CRS proof for the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official OSNI Open Data - Coverage Grid - 10K metadata window confirms that the OSNI 1:10,000 raster grid used as a DTM download reference system is referenced to the Irish Grid and publishes a naming convention, but it does not state that the Belfast City 2006 LiDAR 1 km tiles use this 10K grid or expose North-East archive-internal tile names. Therefore Irish Grid is retained only as reference-grid evidence and is not assigned to the Belfast LiDAR dataset; no tile identifier, geometry or parcel binding is fabricated.
